notes.title: Closed Alpha Is Here!
notes.notes:
🎉 The SOON is NOW! 🎉

Hey everyone,

It’s finally here—the [i]Becoming Pablo[/i] Closed Alpha is LIVE! 🚀

We’re so pumped to have you with us at this stage. Your feedback is going to be the key to making the game truly great, so don’t hold back. Whether it’s something you loved, something that didn’t quite feel right, or even a crazy idea you’ve got—[i]we want to hear it all.[/i]

Head over to the ⁠feedback channel and share your thoughts! This is your space to chat, suggest, and tell us exactly how we can improve. We’re all in this together, and we’re here to listen every step of the way. 💬

[b]If you signed up through the Google Form, check your email for your Closed Alpha access.[/b]

[b]Else, you can request access through our Steam page.[/b]

A few quick things to keep in mind:

[olist]
[*] This is an early version of the game, so you may encounter bugs or features that aren’t fully polished yet.
[*] Some content is still being developed, and things may look or feel different in the final version.
[*] Features you remember from previous builds might be missing or updated. Let us know what you think about these changes!
[*] Your feedback is invaluable—if something feels off or you have ideas for improvements, don’t hesitate to share them in the ⁠feedback channel.
[/olist]

We can’t wait to hear your thoughts. Let’s dive in and make [i]Becoming Pablo[/i] something incredible, together.

Join our Discord to share your feedback: https://discord.gg/DghRTKDqtk

Cheers,
The [i]Becoming Pablo[/i] Team
